registration_boundary: Created after the Qwen dev400 U/BF/WF pilot was known, before the frozen dev400 B/W supplement and full DRS suite were available locally. This is an evidence-triggered descriptive diagnostic, not a confirmatory population experiment.

prerequisites.reason: The audit is CPU-only and may not run until the complete frozen DRS suite has been independently promoted; it never competes with or changes a primary generation job.

source.selection: same first 400 records as the frozen method pilot
source.note: Invalid, truncated, or non-EOS B/W source rows are retained and reported as source failures; they are never dropped to improve certificate coverage.

audit.path: Replay each stored selected token plus EOS through the same exact byte-level-BPE transition and constructive completion oracle under each counterfactual hard horizon.
audit.first_failure: Record the first token rejected by bounded certification, whether the corresponding unbounded transition is locally live, the remaining budget, and any concrete witness distance.
audit.horizon_choice: Fixed 64-token increments ending at the registered 256-token primary cap; every horizon is reported and none is selected after seeing B/W outputs.

report: all attempted rows including invalid/truncated source rows
planner false rejection on in-horizon accepting paths
source, manifest, tokenizer, config, and implementation hashes
claim_boundary: This replay audit measures where an already generated B/W path would encounter finite-horizon pressure. It does not show which alternative BF/WF generation would select, does not estimate a population quality gain, and cannot replace matched B-versus-BF or W-versus-WF generation. A later generation follow-up requires a separate immutable protocol and must retain all negative results.
